data.animaCaption: Leaning close over the office desk in a fitted charcoal waistcoat and half-unbuttoned wine silk shirt, she tugs her own loosened necktie while pinning you with a sharp, slightly flushed gaze from above. A brass banker lamp casts dramatic warm side light across her collar and dark blind shadows behind her.
data.promptProse: Viewed from a low first-person angle at the edge of a dark mahogany desk inside a locked command office, Shiki Natsume leans decisively over the viewer wearing a tailored charcoal waistcoat over a wine-red silk shirt unbuttoned at the collar, a loosened dark tie, and a high-slit pencil skirt. Bracing one hand firmly on the desktop beside you while her other fingers hook her own tie, she holds your gaze with cool dominance and a subtle flush at her cheekbones under the focused amber glow of a vintage desk lamp and sharp blind shadows.
data.story: 原本该由你主导的复盘谈话在三秒内彻底反转。解开两颗衬衫扣子的夏目反身撑住指挥桌边缘俯下身来，指尖慢条斯理拉松暗纹领带，居高临下轻笑一声——「擅自改变撤离路线的时候，怎么没想到今晚要怎么向我交代？」
